Nested authority is clean, detached, remotely authenticated, and pinned at tag `sapianta-system-nested-authority-3183bab-v1`, commit `3183bab71f8f30397c0309dd2e6d846d14a11f66`, tree `7c32ec05efc2be43297849bc38ec8766514a523d`. The historical/composite worktree was not mutated.

The four committed IJ artifacts were reconstructed byte-for-byte. Their Git blobs and SHA-256 identities, canonical JSON bytes, inner reduction seal, and IJ terminal conclusions authenticated. Repository evidence—not prior worker conversation, memory, identity, or prompt assertions—established E05 10/18, FUTURE selected, minimum semantics and owners proven, concrete placement unselected, currentness preserved, arbitrary-head bypass closed, no P11 or production-route delta, no readiness, no operation, and zero credit.

Option B closes IJ's placement ambiguity. Existing repository conventions uniquely support physical names `certification_baseline`, `head`, and `tree`: receipt fields are lower snake case, closed nested objects are used throughout, and FM's exact nested checkout identity pair is `head`/`tree`. The object is closed, required, and limited to two lower-case full Git identities. The IJ minimum therefore remains exactly two new semantic coordinates plus the existing non-identity `runtime_target_selection_binding` evidence structure.

The exact successor version identity is not uniquely derivable. DU/EB/EE expose only their V1 identities and `1.0.0`; DU and EB use `SAPIANTA_...` families while EE uses `G77_256EE_...`; there is no same-family successor registry or DU/EB/EE dispatch precedent. This is valid Terminal B: exact Option-B physical shape and fail-closed predicates formalized; exact version/schema/validator/profile/issuer/consumer identity tuple and successor namespace require a further Human governance decision.

No DU, EB, EE, FM, P11, GN, GL, runtime, historical evidence, or nested-authority owner was modified. IK creates no runtime capability. E05 remains exactly 10/18. G77-256IL is not started.
